notes: Single source for the tool versions that Tools/verification/doctor.py checks and that docs/guides/build-and-test.md shows; regenerate that table with `python3 Tools/verification/doctor.py --markdown`.
Requirements: `>=V` minimum, `V.*` same release series, `==V` exact pin, `unrecorded` = presence only because no version is documented anywhere in the repository.
statedIn lists every other place that restates a version; `{version}` and `{major}` in a phrase are filled from the requirement and test_doctor.py fails when a phrase is missing.
observed records dated runs only; it is evidence, not a supported-version claim.

tiers.public: Needed to build the app and run the public verification lane (what CI runs). No private data.
tiers.optional: Needed only for the named workflow; most of these consume private `.local/` inputs.

tools.name: Apple Silicon Mac
tools.install: Use macOS on Apple Silicon; the app builds for platform=macOS,arch=arm64. The minimum host macOS version is unrecorded.

tools.name: Xcode
tools.install: Install Xcode 26 and select it: sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer

tools.name: Metal compiler
observed: 32023.883 from the MetalToolchain 17.6.109.0 component with Xcode 26.6, CI macos-26-arm64 image 20261013.0424.1, 2026-10-23
tools.install: Install the Xcode Metal Toolchain component: xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain

tools.name: Swift
tools.install: Swift ships with Xcode; select Xcode 26 with xcode-select.

tools.name: Python 3 (python3 on PATH)
observed: 3.15.0, CI macos-26-arm64 image 20261013.0424.1, public lane passed, 2026-10-23
3.11.15, Linux container: mod-tools, runner-self and validator suites passed, 2026-10-23
tools.install: Any python3 on PATH; the public Python suites and the lane runner use the standard library only.

tools.name: .NET SDK
observed: .NET 10.0.10 arm64 runtime with ilspycmd 11.1.0.9782, reference Mac (docs/reference/studio/binary-contracts.md)
SDKs 8.0.101 to 10.0.401 (newest 10.0.401), CI macos-26-arm64 image 20261013.0424.1, translation suite passed, 2026-10-23
tools.install: Install a .NET 10 SDK from https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download and put dotnet on PATH.

tools.name: Python 3.12 venv for Tools/reverse
observed: 3.12, CI reverse-tools job (actions/setup-python); first hosted run 2026-10-01
3.14 could not build the pinned dependencies on the reference Mac (Tools/reverse/README.md)

tools.name: Asset-pipeline python3 (PY)
tools.install: A python3 with numpy and Pillow; Tools/assets/run_all.sh uses $PY, default /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.

tools.name: Blender
tools.install: Install Blender 5.1 at /Applications/Blender.app or set BLENDER=/path/to/Blender (Tools/assets/run_all.sh does not search PATH).

tools.name: Parallels prlctl
tools.install: Install Parallels Desktop with a Windows VM that has guest tools and the game installed; see Tools/reverse/README.md.

capabilities.name: Engine package tests

capabilities.name: Public Python suites and lane runner

capabilities.name: Roslyn translation frontend

capabilities.name: Tools/reverse Python environment

capabilities.name: Bundled asset regeneration
capabilities.exercisedBy: `Tools/assets/run_all.sh`; its ignored MakeHuman sources are not checked
